raw_spatial_{product}.npy: {product}产品完整空间数据 (time, lat, lon)
target_spatial.npy: CHM目标变量空间数据 (time, lat, lon)
target_spatial_valid.npy: CHM目标变量有效时间空间数据
target_points_valid.npy: CHM目标变量有效时间点数据
diff_1_multi_product_mean.npy: 多产品均值一阶差分 (valid_time, points)
diff_1_multi_product_std.npy: 多产品标准差一阶差分 (valid_time, points)
diff_2_multi_product_mean.npy: 多产品均值二阶差分 (valid_time, points)
relative_change_multi_product_mean.npy: 多产品均值相对变化率 (valid_time, points)
product_consistency_ratio.npy: 产品一致性比值(最小/最大) (valid_time, points)
lag_diff_{lag1}_{lag2}_multi_product_mea: 滞后{lag1}天与{lag2}天多产品均值差值 (valid_time, points)
lag_ratio_current_{lag}_multi_product_me: 当前与滞后{lag}天多产品均值比值 (valid_time, points)
lag_{lag}_ma_{window}_multi_product_mean: 滞后{lag}天的{window}天移动平均 (valid_time, points)
min_distance_to_threshold_{threshold}.np: 到阈值{threshold}的最小距离 (valid_time, points)
near_threshold_count_{threshold}.npy: 阈值{threshold}附近的产品数量 (valid_time, points)
low_intensity_conditional_std.npy: 低强度条件下的产品间标准差 (valid_time, points)
low_intensity_conditional_cv.npy: 低强度条件下的变异系数 (valid_time, points)
intensity_bin_{bin_idx}_mean.npy: 基于均值的强度分箱{bin_idx} (valid_time, points)
intensity_bin_{bin_idx}_max.npy: 基于最大值的强度分箱{bin_idx} (valid_time, points)
rain_count_bin_{bin_idx}.npy: 降雨产品数量分箱{bin_idx} (valid_time, points)
target_rolling_quantile_{int(q*100)}.npy: 目标变量滚动{int(q*100)}%分位数 (valid_time, points)
target_anomaly_zscore.npy: 目标变量Z-score异常值标识 (valid_time, points)
interaction_{stat_name}_sin_day.npy: {stat_name}与年内日周期正弦交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_{stat_name}_cos_day.npy: {stat_name}与年内日周期余弦交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_low_intensity_std_cv.npy: 低强度条件下标准差与变异系数交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_high_intensity_mean_max.npy: 高强度条件下均值与最大值交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_rain_count_{stat_name}.npy: 降雨产品数量与{stat_name}交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_current_lag{lag}_mean.npy: 当前与滞后{lag}天均值交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_mean_std_change_lag{lag}.npy: 均值与标准差{lag}天变化交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_exp_std.npy: 多产品标准差指数 (valid_time, points)
interaction_consistency_std.npy: 一致性比值与标准差交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_cv_rain_count.npy: 变异系数与降雨数量交互 (valid_time, points)
interaction_summer_high_intensity_std.np: 夏季高强度条件下的标准差 (valid_time, points)
interaction_winter_low_intensity_cv.npy: 冬季低强度条件下的变异系数 (valid_time, points)
